articles.title: One Penguin Colony Holds Steady While Its Neighbor Shrinks
articles.summary: One colony of rare Erect-crested penguins has held steady for 25 years while its neighbor has shrunk by more than 40 percent — and scientists are piecing together why.

articles.title: A Dead Star Spins Every 8 Minutes and Sends Mysterious Radio Pulses
articles.summary: A dead star spinning every eight minutes sends mysterious radio pulses from a system with a Sun-like companion — the first of its kind ever found.

articles.title: A Gentle Sound Could Boost the Brain's Nighttime Cleaning
articles.summary: MIT researchers found that precisely timed bursts of pink noise during sleep strengthen the brain waves that drive its nighttime cleaning fluid.
